data.title: Mastering Systems by Elimination
data.description: Practice solving pairs of linear equations in standard form by adding or scaling equations to eliminate variables and find integer solutions.

challenges.instruction: Use elimination — add or scale equations so one variable cancels. Then solve and enter (x, y).
challenges.hint: Multiply one or both equations so the x (or y) coefficients are opposites, add to cancel that variable, solve, then back-substitute. Check the pair in both equations.
